steps.title: 畫出海峽限制圖
steps.objective: 區分航道淨空與結構跨距的需求。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish navigation-clearance needs from structural span requirements.
steps.instruction: 自繪兩岸、航道和候選塔位，另以符號標出深水與強潮流區。為每一個塔位寫出一項須由海事或地質資料確認的限制。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch the shores, navigation corridor and candidate tower locations; mark deep water and strong currents separately. For each tower location, name a constraint requiring marine or geological evidence.
steps.observation: 比較塔位移動是否同時改變航道餘裕、側跨與施工可達性。
steps.observationEn: Observe whether moving a tower changes navigation space, side spans and construction access together.
steps.failure: 只保留最短跨距，卻把基礎放入航道或未調查地層。
steps.failureEn: Minimizing span alone can place foundations in a navigation corridor or uninvestigated ground.
steps.check: 提交有圖例的限制圖，至少保留兩項尚待查證的資料。
steps.checkEn: Submit a keyed constraint map with at least two unresolved evidence needs.

knowledge.title: 多目標選址
knowledge.text: 塔位同時影響結構、航運和施工；跨距不是唯一決策量。
knowledge.textEn: Tower placement affects structure, navigation and construction; span is only one decision variable.

knowledge.title: 資料不確定性
knowledge.text: 未量測的水深或地層不能因示意圖畫得完整就視為已確認。
knowledge.textEn: A complete-looking sketch does not verify unmeasured depth or ground conditions.

options: 航道、地盤與施工限制是否不同
只比較總橋重，認為其可代表所有場址限制
先假定兩地地盤完全相同
optionsEn: Differences in navigation, ground and construction constraints
Compare total bridge weight as if it represented every site constraint
Assume identical ground conditions first
quiz.question: 兩個塔位方案跨距相近，下一個合理比較是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Two tower layouts have similar spans. What should be compared next?
quiz.explanation: 相近的跨距不代表相同的外部條件，必須比較限制與證據缺口。
quiz.explanationEn: Similar spans do not imply similar external conditions; compare constraints and evidence gaps.

steps.title: 追蹤懸索橋載荷路徑
steps.objective: 辨認吊索、主纜、塔與錨碇的不同角色。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the distinct roles of hangers, main cables, towers and anchorages.
steps.instruction: 在自繪側視圖把一個橋面載荷依序連到吊索及主纜，再分別追蹤塔的支承和端部錨碇的反力。另畫一條溫度伸縮方向箭頭。
steps.instructionEn: On a side-view sketch, trace a deck load through hangers and main cables, then identify tower support and end-anchorage reactions. Add a separate thermal-movement arrow.
steps.observation: 注意吊索大致垂直，而主纜曲線連續通過塔頂。
steps.observationEn: Notice the approximately vertical hangers and the main cable continuing over the towers.
steps.failure: 把主纜當成從塔頂直接放射到橋面的斜張索。
steps.failureEn: Mistaking the main cable for separate stays radiating directly from a tower to the deck.
steps.check: 載荷路徑須包含錨碇，且與伸縮箭頭使用不同圖例。
steps.checkEn: Include anchorages in the load path and distinguish force arrows from movement arrows.

knowledge.title: 懸索與斜張
knowledge.text: 懸索橋以主纜與吊索承托橋面；斜張橋的斜索直接連結塔與梁。
knowledge.textEn: A suspension bridge supports its deck through main cables and hangers; stays connect a cable-stayed deck directly to towers.

knowledge.title: 反力閉合
knowledge.text: 辨識拉力仍須追查由哪個支承或地盤提供平衡反力。
knowledge.textEn: Identifying tension also requires locating the support or ground that balances it.

options: 吊索到橋面的局部傳力已完整，所以不需其他反力
主纜端部拉力的反力路徑
主塔承受壓力即可代替所有端部反力
optionsEn: Local hanger-to-deck transfer is complete, so no further reaction is needed
The reaction path for end cable tension
Tower compression can replace all end reactions
quiz.question: 如果示意圖刪掉主纜端部的錨碇，主要遺漏是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What is chiefly missing if a sketch omits the main-cable anchorages?
quiz.explanation: 錨碇是懸索系統的受力邊界，不能只畫橋面、塔和吊索。
quiz.explanationEn: Anchorages define the suspension system’s force boundary; deck, towers and hangers alone are incomplete.

steps.title: 拆解海中基礎介面
steps.objective: 辨識海床、基礎與橋塔交界各需什麼證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify evidence needed at seabed, foundation and tower interfaces.
steps.instruction: 畫出海床剖面、基礎底面與塔座，列出承載、變形、海床變化三類問題。將施工定位紀錄與營運期海床觀測分成兩欄。
steps.instructionEn: Draw seabed, foundation base and tower seat. List bearing, deformation and bed-change questions, separating construction-position records from operational seabed observations.
steps.observation: 觀察同一塔頂位移可能來自基礎轉動或塔本身變形。
steps.observationEn: Recognize that tower-top movement may result from foundation rotation or tower deformation.
steps.failure: 把單一塔頂讀數直接認定為海床承載失效。
steps.failureEn: Treating one tower-top reading as proof of seabed bearing failure.
steps.check: 為三類問題各指定一種觀察量，並寫明無法由它單獨判定的事項。
steps.checkEn: Assign one observable to each question and state what it cannot establish alone.

knowledge.title: 支承條件
knowledge.text: 基礎的受力與變形都會影響上部結構的邊界條件。
knowledge.textEn: Foundation forces and deformations both affect superstructure boundary conditions.

knowledge.title: 分層量測
knowledge.text: 塔頂、塔座及地盤的相對量測有助於區分變形來源。
knowledge.textEn: Relative measurements at tower top, base and ground help distinguish deformation sources.

options: 只增加同一位置讀數次數，不核對支承
另一次未註記時間的塔頂照片
塔座位移與環境條件的同期紀錄
optionsEn: Repeat readings at the same point without checking support
Another tower-top photograph with no timestamp
Concurrent tower-base displacement and environmental records
quiz.question: 塔頂偏移增加時，哪組補充資料最有助診斷？
quiz.questionEn: Which additional data best helps diagnose increased tower-top displacement?
quiz.explanation: 同步的支承與環境紀錄可檢查不同假說，單點讀數不能定位原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronized support and environmental records test competing explanations; one reading cannot locate the cause.

steps.title: 核對錨碇與纜索交接
steps.objective: 將端部受力模型連結到幾何與耐久檢查。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect an end-force model to geometry and durability checks.
steps.instruction: 自繪主纜進入錨碇的簡圖，標出拉力傳遞、可檢查空間與水分進入方向。把錨碇和橋塔基礎列成兩個不同構件。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch a main cable entering an anchorage; mark force transfer, inspection space and possible moisture entry. List the anchorage separately from the tower foundation.
steps.observation: 檢查力能否從纜索一路追蹤到錨碇與地盤。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the force path can be followed continuously from cable to anchorage and ground.
steps.failure: 以表面塗層完好推論整個錨碇內部都乾燥且健全。
steps.failureEn: Inferring a dry, sound anchorage interior solely from intact surface coating.
steps.check: 交付受力圖與耐久疑問各一張，註明需要的內部證據。
steps.checkEn: Provide a force sketch and a durability-question sheet naming the necessary internal evidence.

knowledge.title: 構件職責
knowledge.text: 主塔支承主纜，端部錨碇承接纜索端力；兩者不應混為一談。
knowledge.textEn: Towers support main cables while end anchorages resist end forces; these roles differ.

knowledge.title: 可檢查性
knowledge.text: 無法直接看見的介面，需要事先規劃可追溯的檢查方法。
knowledge.textEn: Hidden interfaces require planned, traceable inspection methods.

options: 有位置與日期的內部檢查及濕度紀錄
只增加外表面檢查，假定內部條件一致
以當日車流估算內部濕度
optionsEn: Located, dated internal inspection and humidity records
Increase external inspection and assume the interior matches
Infer internal humidity from the day’s traffic
quiz.question: 哪項證據最能補足錨碇外觀照片的限制？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence best supplements external anchorage photographs?
quiz.explanation: 內部環境和檢查位置才直接對應隱蔽介面的疑問。
quiz.explanationEn: Internal conditions and inspection locations directly address hidden-interface questions.

stages.title: 海峽與受力系統
stages.description: 先把航道、地盤與懸索受力放在同一概念模型中。
stages.descriptionEn: Put navigation, ground conditions and suspension load paths in one conceptual model.

steps.title: 比較主纜形狀與載荷
steps.objective: 理解纜索幾何與張力不能分開指定。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand why cable geometry and tension cannot be specified independently.
steps.instruction: 以鬆弛繩模型或自繪曲線比較兩種下垂程度，在圖上放入相同的示意橋面載荷。只作定性判讀，列出求數值時還缺的材料和邊界資料。
steps.instructionEn: Compare two cable sags using loose string or sketches under the same illustrative deck load. Keep conclusions qualitative and list missing material and boundary data for numerical analysis.
steps.observation: 觀察曲線變平時，端部力的方向也改變。
steps.observationEn: Observe that flattening the cable changes the end-force direction.
steps.failure: 把下垂量減少誤認為必然能降低所有纜索力。
steps.failureEn: Assuming reduced sag necessarily reduces every cable force.
steps.check: 圖中保留相同載荷假設，並說明不能由外形直接求出張力。
steps.checkEn: Keep the load assumption identical and explain why shape alone cannot give tension.

knowledge.title: 柔性纜索
knowledge.text: 纜索主要以拉力傳力，平衡形狀會隨載荷與支承位置改變。
knowledge.textEn: A cable primarily carries tension; its equilibrium shape depends on loading and support positions.

knowledge.title: 模型限制
knowledge.text: 繩模型未重現鋼纜剛度、溫度與橋面剛性，只展示幾何關係。
knowledge.textEn: A string model illustrates geometry without reproducing steel-cable stiffness, temperature effects or deck rigidity.

options: 只控制圖上的跨度，允許載荷不同
載荷與支承條件的假設
只控制纜索材料，忽略支承位置
optionsEn: Hold only drawn span constant while changing the load
Assumptions about loading and supports
Hold only cable material constant and ignore support positions
quiz.question: 想比較兩種垂度的受力，哪項必須先控制一致？
quiz.questionEn: What should first be held consistent when comparing forces for two sags?
quiz.explanation: 在不同載荷或支承下看到的差異不能只歸因於垂度。
quiz.explanationEn: Differences under changed loads or supports cannot be attributed to sag alone.

steps.title: 追蹤分段架設狀態
steps.objective: 區分施工中與完工後的平衡系統。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish construction-stage equilibrium from the completed system.
steps.instruction: 把橋面分成六個示意區段，自選兩種安裝先後並逐格畫出已連接構件。每一格標記不平衡載荷與尚未形成的連續性，不安排真實吊裝。
steps.instructionEn: Divide the deck into six illustrative segments and sketch two assembly sequences. For each state mark unbalanced loads and missing continuity; do not plan an actual lift.
steps.observation: 比較單側增加一段橋面時，主纜和鄰近吊索的受力路徑如何改變。
steps.observationEn: Compare load-path changes in the main cable and adjacent hangers when a segment is added on one side.
steps.failure: 直接套用完工橋的支承與連續性來評估每個施工格。
steps.failureEn: Applying completed-bridge support and continuity assumptions to every construction state.
steps.check: 選出一個最需要重新分析的中間狀態，說明理由與缺少資料。
steps.checkEn: Select an intermediate state needing renewed analysis and explain why and what data is missing.

knowledge.title: 階段結構
knowledge.text: 構件尚未連接時，完工後的載荷重分配途徑可能不存在。
knowledge.textEn: Load redistribution available after completion may not exist before components are connected.

knowledge.title: 工序依賴
knowledge.text: 幾何調整和構件接合的結果會成為下一階段的初始條件。
knowledge.textEn: Geometry adjustment and connection outcomes become initial conditions for the next stage.

options: 中間狀態可直接沿用完工載荷分配
每個中間狀態都必定比完工更安全
未完成結構的連接與載荷不同
optionsEn: Intermediate states can use final load distribution unchanged
Every intermediate state is necessarily safer than completion
Connections and loads differ in an incomplete structure
quiz.question: 哪個理由最能說明需要施工階段分析？
quiz.questionEn: What best explains the need for construction-stage analysis?
quiz.explanation: 需要檢查的是當時實際存在的結構系統，而非只看終態。
quiz.explanationEn: The relevant structure is the one that exists at that stage, not only the final state.

steps.title: 重建地震後測量基準
steps.objective: 理解基準變動如何影響尚未製造的構件。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand how changed reference geometry affects unfabricated components.
steps.instruction: 依 1995 年事件畫出「地震前控制點—震後復測—更新模型—複核構件」流程。用自設的小位移示例，分開記錄地盤移動與構件相對變形。
steps.instructionEn: Based on the 1995 event, map pre-event controls, resurvey, model update and component review. In a clearly invented displacement example, separate ground movement from relative component deformation.
steps.observation: 比較兩塔間距變化與塔本身損傷是否是不同證據問題。
steps.observationEn: Distinguish a changed tower spacing from evidence of damage within a tower.
steps.failure: 控制點移動後，仍把舊座標當成固定真值調整構件。
steps.failureEn: Adjusting components to old coordinates after the control points have moved.
steps.check: 記錄示例新舊基準、相對距離與待重審構件，禁止把示例值當實測。
steps.checkEn: Record old and new references, relative distances and components needing review; label every example value as invented.

knowledge.title: 共同位移
knowledge.text: 地盤與基礎共同移動，與基礎對地盤滑動，是不同的機制。
knowledge.textEn: Ground and foundation moving together differs from a foundation sliding relative to ground.

knowledge.title: 版本追溯
knowledge.text: 幾何基準修訂要能追溯到分析模型與待製構件版本。
knowledge.textEn: A revised geometric reference must be traceable to model and component versions.

options: 仍須復測並檢查模型與構件介面
外觀正常即可忽略幾何改變
立即判定所有基礎已滑動
optionsEn: Resurvey and review model and component interfaces
Normal appearance makes geometry changes irrelevant
Conclude immediately that all foundations slid
quiz.question: 震後塔距改變，但構件外觀無明顯損傷，應如何解讀？
quiz.questionEn: Tower spacing changes after an earthquake without visible member damage. What follows?
quiz.explanation: 外觀、相對位移與受力是不同證據層次，須整合後判斷。
quiz.explanationEn: Appearance, relative displacement and force behavior are different evidence layers that must be reconciled.

steps.title: 分辨靜風與振動問題
steps.objective: 識別風力、變形與振動穩定性所需的不同模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify different models for wind force, deformation and dynamic stability.
steps.instruction: 為靜態側向風力、渦激反應與扭轉振動各寫一個研究問題。以自繪位移—時間曲線比較衰減、持續與增長，避免賦予真實橋梁限值。
steps.instructionEn: Write separate questions about static crosswind force, vortex-induced response and torsional vibration. Sketch decaying, sustained and growing motion without assigning real-bridge limits.
steps.observation: 觀察平均位移相近的曲線，振幅隨時間的變化仍可能不同。
steps.observationEn: Curves with similar mean displacement can have different amplitude trends over time.
steps.failure: 只檢查最大靜態撓度，就宣稱已驗證所有風振現象。
steps.failureEn: Claiming all wind behavior is verified by checking maximum static deflection alone.
steps.check: 將三種問題配對到合適的觀察量，標示定性曲線。
steps.checkEn: Match the three questions to suitable observables and label curves as qualitative.

knowledge.title: 時間尺度
knowledge.text: 穩定平均風荷載與反覆振動需要不同的證據描述。
knowledge.textEn: Steady mean wind loading and repeated oscillation require different evidence descriptions.

knowledge.title: 能量與阻尼
knowledge.text: 阻尼消散振動能量；它與單純提高靜態剛度的作用不同。
knowledge.textEn: Damping dissipates vibration energy, which differs from simply increasing static stiffness.

options: 圖上平均位移的方向
振幅是否隨時間增長
圖中使用的長度單位
optionsEn: Direction of the plotted mean displacement
Whether vibration amplitude grows over time
Length units shown on the plot
quiz.question: 哪個現象無法由一張平均撓度圖充分判斷？
quiz.questionEn: What cannot be adequately judged from a mean-deflection plot?
quiz.explanation: 振動增長需要時間或動態穩定性資訊；平均量會隱藏它。
quiz.explanationEn: Growth requires time-dependent or stability information; averages can hide it.

stages.title: 架設與幾何控制
stages.description: 比較未完成結構的平衡、基準變更與風振假設。
stages.descriptionEn: Compare incomplete-structure equilibrium, changed survey references and wind-response assumptions.

steps.title: 畫出主纜乾燥屏障
steps.objective: 說明外包覆與內部乾燥的互補關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how wrapping and internal drying complement each other.
steps.instruction: 自繪主纜包覆、送氣、排氣及濕度觀測點的功能圖。為「包覆局部進水」與「送氣中斷」各列一項可觀察證據，不指定設備參數。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch functional roles of cable wrapping, air supply, exhaust and humidity observations. For local water ingress and interrupted air supply, name evidence without specifying operating parameters.
steps.observation: 檢查進氣正常是否仍可能與局部高濕並存。
steps.observationEn: Ask whether normal inlet air can coexist with a locally humid region.
steps.failure: 以乾燥機正在運轉，取代主纜內部環境的證據。
steps.failureEn: Substituting evidence that a dryer is running for evidence about conditions inside the cable.
steps.check: 圖上須有兩個不同失效路徑與對應觀察點。
steps.checkEn: Include two distinct failure paths and corresponding observation locations.

knowledge.title: 防蝕多重屏障
knowledge.text: 外包覆抑制水分進入，乾燥系統改善內部環境；兩者提供不同功能。
knowledge.textEn: Wrapping limits moisture entry while drying changes internal conditions; the functions differ.

knowledge.title: 代表性採樣
knowledge.text: 一個位置的濕度，不能自動代表整條纜索的狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Humidity measured at one point does not automatically represent the entire cable.

options: 直接把遠端讀值刪除
用乾燥機功率證明全纜乾燥
核對量測與局部氣流或包覆異常
optionsEn: Delete the distant reading
Use dryer power as proof the entire cable is dry
Check measurements and local airflow or wrapping anomalies
quiz.question: 送氣端讀值正常而遠端濕度偏高，最合理的下一步是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Inlet readings are normal but a distant point is humid. What is the best next review?
quiz.explanation: 不同位置的差異可能提供局部失效線索，須先查證。
quiz.explanationEn: Differences between locations may reveal local failure and require verification.

steps.title: 辨認重複載荷與接頭
steps.objective: 區分疲勞、腐蝕與單次超載的證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish evidence of fatigue, corrosion and one-time overload.
steps.instruction: 在自繪鋼橋面接頭示意上標記幾何變化處，建立三欄：反覆交通載荷、水分滯留、單次異常事件。為每欄列一種需要查證的紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Mark geometric changes on a steel-deck connection sketch. Create columns for repeated traffic loading, trapped moisture and a single abnormal event, assigning evidence to each.
steps.observation: 留意細小裂紋的位置及歷次變化，比單一遠景照片更具診斷性。
steps.observationEn: Crack location and change over time are more diagnostic than one distant photograph.
steps.failure: 看到鏽色就把所有裂紋歸因於腐蝕，忽略載荷歷程。
steps.failureEn: Attributing every crack to corrosion because rust is visible, without considering load history.
steps.check: 完成三種機制的證據表，至少列一項仍不能排除的替代解釋。
steps.checkEn: Complete the three-mechanism evidence table and retain at least one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 局部細節
knowledge.text: 幾何不連續可能集中應力；整體受力正常不保證每個接頭無問題。
knowledge.textEn: Geometric discontinuities can concentrate stress; normal global behavior does not prove every connection sound.

knowledge.title: 機制辨識
knowledge.text: 裂紋形態、環境與載荷歷程應一起判讀，不能只靠顏色。
knowledge.textEn: Crack form, environment and load history should be interpreted together rather than from color alone.

options: 同位置、同尺度的歷次量測
不同位置的裂紋照片但沒有時間對照
只記錄當日總車流，不核對裂紋位置
optionsEn: Repeated measurements at the same location and scale
Crack photographs from different locations without time comparison
Record only daily traffic without locating the crack
quiz.question: 哪項資料最有助區分持續發展的裂紋與穩定表面痕跡？
quiz.questionEn: Which data best distinguishes a developing crack from a stable surface mark?
quiz.explanation: 可比較的時間序列才提供變化證據；外觀單照缺少發展資訊。
quiz.explanationEn: Comparable time-series observations provide change evidence that a single image lacks.

steps.title: 校正監測比較條件
steps.objective: 避免把溫度或儀器差異誤認為結構劣化。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid mistaking environmental or instrument differences for structural deterioration.
steps.instruction: 自行製作含時間、溫度、風況、感測器和位移的六列示例表。選出可直接比較的兩列，再為其餘列註記需校正或補查的條件。
steps.instructionEn: Create a six-row example table with time, temperature, wind, sensor and displacement. Select two comparable rows and mark conditions requiring adjustment or investigation in the others.
steps.observation: 觀察位移異常是否與換感測器或環境改變同時發生。
steps.observationEn: See whether displacement changes coincide with sensor replacement or environmental changes.
steps.failure: 把不同零點或不同溫度的資料直接相減，產生假趨勢。
steps.failureEn: Direct subtraction across different zero references or temperatures creates a false trend.
steps.check: 保留原始示例值、比較依據與未解釋的殘差，不覆寫原紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Retain original example values, comparison criteria and unexplained residuals without overwriting records.

knowledge.title: 基線條件
knowledge.text: 基線不只是單一數值，還包括量測時間、環境、設備與基準。
knowledge.textEn: A baseline includes time, environment, instrument and reference, not just one value.

knowledge.title: 可重現性
knowledge.text: 他人應能利用相同選取規則重建你的比較結果。
knowledge.textEn: Another reviewer should reproduce the comparison using the same selection rules.

options: 直接宣告主纜斷裂
新舊感測器的零點和交接紀錄
把前後資料平均後忽略跳變
optionsEn: Immediately declare main-cable rupture
Old and new sensor zero references and handover records
Average the records and disregard the jump
quiz.question: 更換感測器當天出現位移跳變，應優先核對什麼？
quiz.questionEn: A displacement jump appears on the day a sensor is replaced. What should be checked first?
quiz.explanation: 先排查量測系統變動，再結合結構和環境證據判讀。
quiz.explanationEn: Check measurement-system changes before interpreting structural and environmental evidence.

steps.title: 交付懸索橋證據卷宗
steps.objective: 把結構、施工與維護的未解問題交接清楚。
steps.objectiveEn: Clearly hand over unresolved structural, construction and maintenance questions.
steps.instruction: 把前述圖表整理成索引：載荷路徑、基準版本、架設狀態、風振問題及纜索防蝕。對每份資料註明來源、假設與支持的判斷範圍。
steps.instructionEn: Index your load-path, reference-version, erection-state, wind-response and corrosion records. For each, identify source, assumptions and the conclusion it can support.
steps.observation: 檢查是否把某一階段的分析誤用為整橋所有狀態的證明。
steps.observationEn: Check whether evidence for one stage has been mistaken for proof of every bridge state.
steps.failure: 只交付漂亮模型，沒有資料版本、量測條件或待確認事項。
steps.failureEn: Delivering an attractive model without versions, measurement conditions or unresolved items.
steps.check: 以「已支持／未支持／需專業複核」分類至少五項判斷。
steps.checkEn: Classify at least five conclusions as supported, unsupported or requiring professional review.

knowledge.title: 證據對應
knowledge.text: 每項結論需對應適用狀態與資料，不能用一張圖概括全生命週期。
knowledge.textEn: Each conclusion requires applicable conditions and evidence; one sketch cannot cover an entire life cycle.

knowledge.title: 教育交付
knowledge.text: 課程完成代表學習證據齊備，不等於取得真橋施工或通行安全認證。
knowledge.textEn: Course completion records learning evidence, not construction or operational safety certification for the real bridge.

options: 只保留沒有圖例的完工圖像
刪除所有不確定事項以顯得完整
含來源版本、假設與未解問題的索引
optionsEn: Only a finished image without a key
Delete uncertainties to make the work look complete
An index with source versions, assumptions and open questions
quiz.question: 哪份交付最適合另一位工程學徒接續？
quiz.questionEn: Which handover best enables another learner to continue?
quiz.explanation: 可追溯性使下一位能看出已知與未知，避免把示意當定案。
quiz.explanationEn: Traceability distinguishes known from unknown and prevents treating a sketch as an approved design.

stages.title: 耐久與營運證據
stages.description: 把纜索、鋼構與感測紀錄連結到可追溯的維護判斷。
stages.descriptionEn: Connect cable, steelwork and sensor records to traceable maintenance decisions.

courses.title: 明石海峽大橋
courses.summary: 從海峽條件到主纜防蝕，拆解懸索橋的受力、施工幾何與營運證據。
courses.summaryEn: Trace a suspension bridge from strait conditions to cable corrosion protection through load paths, construction geometry and operating evidence.
courses.scope: 以公開資料建立的原創教學分解；所有步驟為紙上、數位模型與證據判讀練習。自繪的示意與自設資料必須標示假設；本站未提供現地工程資料，亦不是核准施工、設備操作或水質放行程序。
courses.scopeEn: Original educational decomposition of public information. Every step is a paper, digital-model or evidence-interpretation exercise. Label assumptions in self-drawn diagrams and invented data; this site does not supply field engineering records or approved construction, operating or water-release procedures.

steps.title: 建立地層與路線剖面
steps.objective: 分開已觀測地層與推估延伸。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate observed strata from inferred continuity.
steps.instruction: 自繪兩岸及海床，將白堊泥灰岩畫成有厚度的帶狀層。以實線代表假設鑽孔位置、虛線表示孔間推論，另標出可能含水或破碎區。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch both coasts and seabed with a chalk-marl band. Mark hypothetical boreholes with solid symbols and inferred continuity with dashed lines; add potentially wet or fractured zones.
steps.observation: 觀察最短直線是否始終位於選定地層內。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the shortest straight alignment stays inside the selected layer.
steps.failure: 把「主要穿越某地層」誤解成全線均質且不會滲水。
steps.failureEn: Treating a dominant stratum as proof of uniform, watertight conditions everywhere.
steps.check: 剖面須有觀測／推論圖例及兩處需補充調查的位置。
steps.checkEn: Include an observation/inference key and two locations needing further investigation.

knowledge.title: 地層追蹤
knowledge.text: 路線可以為了維持較合適地層而調整，不必是兩點最短連線。
knowledge.textEn: Alignment may follow favorable ground rather than the shortest line between two points.

knowledge.title: 局部差異
knowledge.text: 斷層、褶皺和含水差異會使同名岩層的施工表現不同。
knowledge.textEn: Faults, folding and water conditions can change behavior within a named rock layer.

options: 標成推論並列出驗證需求
延用最近鑽孔結果當成全段實測
從剖面刪掉不確定區
optionsEn: As an inference with a verification need
Treat the nearest borehole as measurement of the whole interval
Remove the uncertain area from the section
quiz.question: 鑽孔間出現未確認的構造，應如何標記？
quiz.questionEn: How should an unconfirmed feature between boreholes be shown?
quiz.explanation: 地質模型應保留不確定性，讓後續觀察能修正它。
quiz.explanationEn: A geological model should preserve uncertainty so subsequent observations can revise it.

steps.title: 連結兩岸測量基準
steps.titleEn: Connect survey references on both shores
steps.objective: 理解長距離對向掘進的基準一致性。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand reference consistency in long opposing drives.
steps.instruction: 畫出地面控制網、井下傳遞點與隧道導線的關係。用自設兩岸座標示例，先核對單位、方向與高程基準，再比較預期會合位置。
steps.instructionEn: Diagram surface controls, underground transfer points and tunnel traverses. With invented coordinates from both shores, reconcile units, orientation and height datum before comparing predicted meeting positions.
steps.observation: 比較共同偏移和兩側相向軸線不一致造成的不同結果。
steps.observationEn: Compare a common offset with disagreement between opposing drive axes.
steps.failure: 未統一高程基準，就把兩側標高差當成施工誤差。
steps.failureEn: Treating height differences as construction error before reconciling datums.
steps.check: 交付一張基準對照表及一個可重現的示例閉合檢查。
steps.checkEn: Submit a reference table and a reproducible example closure check.

knowledge.title: 基準傳遞
knowledge.text: 地面控制需經過可追溯的傳遞才能用於地下方向判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Surface control must be transferred traceably before underground directions can be interpreted.

knowledge.title: 誤差累積
knowledge.text: 長距離測量的小方向誤差可能累積成明顯位置差。
knowledge.textEn: Small directional errors over long distances can accumulate into substantial positional differences.

options: 立即修改襯砌環直徑
單位、基準面及控制點版本
只採用數字較小的一組
optionsEn: Immediately change lining-ring diameter
Units, datum and control-point versions
Use whichever numbers are smaller
quiz.question: 兩隊高程數字不一致時，第一項核對是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Two teams report different elevations. What should be checked first?
quiz.explanation: 先確定數據在同一參考系，才能判斷幾何偏差。
quiz.explanationEn: Data must share a reference system before geometric discrepancies are assessed.

steps.title: 選擇開挖配置的證據
steps.objective: 把機台功能與地層及地下水問題配對。
steps.objectiveEn: Match machine functions to ground and groundwater questions.
steps.instruction: 建立硬度、裂隙、含水與出碴四列需求表，分別說明刀盤、工作面支承、密封與運輸的角色。比較英法兩側條件可能不同的理由，不填操作壓力。
steps.instructionEn: Create a table for strength, fractures, water and spoil handling; identify cutting, face support, sealing and transport roles. Explain why the two shores may need different configurations without specifying operating pressures.
steps.observation: 觀察「能切削岩石」與「能管理水及出碴」是否是不同能力。
steps.observationEn: Distinguish ability to cut rock from ability to manage water and spoil.
steps.failure: 只以隧道直徑挑選機台，忽略地層與水壓條件。
steps.failureEn: Selecting a machine by tunnel diameter alone while ignoring ground and water conditions.
steps.check: 每項功能至少連到一項地質證據或待調查事項。
steps.checkEn: Link each function to geological evidence or an investigation need.

knowledge.title: 適地配置
knowledge.text: 同一工程可採用不同配置，以回應各段地層與地下水差異。
knowledge.textEn: One project may use different configurations to address sectional ground and groundwater differences.

knowledge.title: 連續物流
knowledge.text: 切削、出碴與環片供應互相制約；單一速度不能代表整體能力。
knowledge.textEn: Cutting, spoil removal and segment supply constrain one another; one speed does not represent total capability.

options: 直徑相同就必須使用相同配置
只需改變列車速度
工作面支承與密封需求仍可能不同
optionsEn: Equal diameter requires identical configuration
Only train speed needs changing
Face-support and sealing requirements may still differ
quiz.question: 兩段隧道直徑相同但含水條件不同，哪個結論合理？
quiz.questionEn: Two sections share a diameter but differ in water conditions. Which conclusion is reasonable?
quiz.explanation: 直徑只是幾何要求；地下水和地層決定另外的功能需求。
quiz.explanationEn: Diameter defines geometry; ground and groundwater impose additional functional requirements.

steps.title: 用開挖觀察修訂地質模型
steps.titleEn: Update the ground model from excavation observations
steps.objective: 建立預測與現地觀察不一致時的判讀流程。
steps.objectiveEn: Define a response when predictions and field observations disagree.
steps.instruction: 自行寫三則示例觀察：出碴性質改變、滲水增加、測量方向偏移。分別列出可能機制、需補查紀錄與模型要修訂的欄位。
steps.instructionEn: Invent three observations: changed spoil, increased ingress and a survey-direction shift. For each, list candidate mechanisms, records to check and model fields to revise.
steps.observation: 注意相同表徵可以有地質、設備或量測等不同原因。
steps.observationEn: Recognize that the same symptom may have geological, equipment or measurement causes.
steps.failure: 因原模型標示低透水，就把新增滲水當成量測錯誤刪除。
steps.failureEn: Discarding increased ingress as measurement error because the original model predicts low permeability.
steps.check: 至少保留兩種競爭假說，並寫出可區分它們的證據。
steps.checkEn: Retain at least two competing explanations and evidence that could distinguish them.

knowledge.title: 觀察回饋
knowledge.text: 地質預測應接受新證據檢驗；模型不是現地狀態的保證。
knowledge.textEn: Geological predictions must be tested against new evidence; a model does not guarantee field conditions.

knowledge.title: 可區分證據
knowledge.text: 有用的補查應能讓不同假說產生不同預期結果。
knowledge.textEn: Useful follow-up evidence produces different expected results under competing explanations.

options: 保留原版本，加入新觀察並重新評估
只保留原先最有利的假設
把兩種現象平均成一個正常值
optionsEn: Preserve the old version, add observations and reassess
Retain only the original favorable assumption
Average both symptoms into a normal value
quiz.question: 出碴變化與新滲水同時發生時，應如何處理模型？
quiz.questionEn: Spoil changes and new water ingress occur together. How should the model be treated?
quiz.explanation: 版本化修訂保留決策依據，並讓新增證據改變推論。
quiz.explanationEn: Versioned revision preserves decision context while allowing new evidence to change conclusions.

stages.title: 地質、測量與開挖
stages.description: 把預期地層、實際觀察與開挖配置建立可修訂的對照。
stages.descriptionEn: Build a revisable comparison between expected ground, observations and excavation configuration.

steps.title: 檢查襯砌環與接縫
steps.objective: 分清承載、防水與幾何接合證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate evidence for load support, water control and geometric fit.
steps.instruction: 畫一圈分片襯砌及相鄰兩環，標記接縫、接觸面與可能漏水路徑。建立環片識別、位置、缺損和接縫觀察的記錄欄位。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a segmented ring and two adjacent rings, marking joints, contacts and potential ingress paths. Define records for segment identity, location, defects and joint observations.
steps.observation: 比較環片本體完整與接縫完整是否能互相替代。
steps.observationEn: Ask whether sound segment bodies and sound joints provide interchangeable evidence.
steps.failure: 環片外表沒有裂縫，就認定所有接縫都止水良好。
steps.failureEn: Assuming every joint is watertight because segment faces have no visible cracks.
steps.check: 為承載、幾何、防水各列一種不同的檢核證據。
steps.checkEn: Name distinct evidence for support, geometry and water control.

knowledge.title: 系統接縫
knowledge.text: 襯砌不是孤立環片的集合；環內與環間接合會影響整體性能。
knowledge.textEn: Lining behavior depends on within-ring and between-ring joints, not only isolated segments.

knowledge.title: 位置追溯
knowledge.text: 缺陷紀錄須能回到具體環號與方位，才能比較後續變化。
knowledge.textEn: Defect records need ring identity and orientation to support later comparisons.

options: 全隧道環片總數
同環號、方位及時間的觀察序列
未註位置的零散照片
optionsEn: Total number of tunnel segments
Observations with matching ring, orientation and timestamps
Unlocated photographs
quiz.question: 哪項記錄最適合追蹤接縫漏水是否擴大？
quiz.questionEn: Which record best tracks whether joint leakage is spreading?
quiz.explanation: 可定位、可比較的紀錄才支持變化判斷。
quiz.explanationEn: Located and comparable records support judgments about change.

steps.title: 區分漏水來源與排水路徑
steps.titleEn: Distinguish ingress sources from drainage paths
steps.objective: 解釋抽排能力不等於止水成功。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain why pumping capacity does not prove successful water exclusion.
steps.instruction: 自繪接縫、集水溝、集水井和抽排出口，分別用箭頭表示外水進入與收集輸送。以示例時間表比較降雨、漏水位置及抽排量。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch joints, drains, sumps and discharge, using different arrows for water ingress and collection. Compare rainfall, leak locations and pumping in an invented timeline.
steps.observation: 觀察集水量變化可能來自入流改變，也可能來自排水路徑堵塞。
steps.observationEn: Changes in collected flow may reflect altered inflow or blocked drainage routes.
steps.failure: 抽水機仍運轉就推論沒有漏水，或流量下降就推論問題改善。
steps.failureEn: Inferring no ingress because pumps run, or improvement because measured flow falls.
steps.check: 指出兩種使觀測流量下降的不同情境與辨別資料。
steps.checkEn: Identify two different causes of reduced measured flow and evidence distinguishing them.

knowledge.title: 入流與輸送
knowledge.text: 滲入隧道的水與被量測到的排水，可能因蓄積或堵塞而不同。
knowledge.textEn: Ingress and measured drainage can differ because of storage or obstruction.

knowledge.title: 水量平衡
knowledge.text: 在有明確時間範圍的模型中，入流、出流和蓄積須互相一致。
knowledge.textEn: In a time-bounded model, inflow, outflow and storage change must be consistent.

options: 只確認供電存在，便排除所有排水問題
直接宣告外水已減少
收集及輸送路徑是否受阻
optionsEn: Confirm supply power and rule out all drainage problems
Immediately conclude external ingress has decreased
Whether collection or conveyance is obstructed
quiz.question: 排水量下降但局部積水升高，最應檢查什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Drainage flow falls while local ponding rises. What most needs checking?
quiz.explanation: 流量與積水相反變化提示輸送問題，需核查路徑和量測。
quiz.explanationEn: Opposing flow and ponding trends suggest a conveyance issue requiring route and measurement checks.

steps.title: 辨認三條隧道的功能
steps.objective: 將交通、維護與避難功能在圖中分開。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate traffic, maintenance and refuge functions on a diagram.
steps.instruction: 自繪兩條行車隧道和中央服務隧道，再加入聯絡通道。用三種線型表示列車路線、維護通行與示意撤離方向，避免填入真實緊急操作命令。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch two running tunnels and a central service tunnel with cross-passages. Use distinct line styles for trains, maintenance and illustrative evacuation, without issuing real emergency instructions.
steps.observation: 觀察聯絡通道與供列車換線的橫渡洞室是否是不同構造。
steps.observationEn: Distinguish pedestrian/service cross-passages from rail crossover caverns.
steps.failure: 把服務隧道畫成第三條正常載客鐵路。
steps.failureEn: Drawing the service tunnel as a third regular passenger railway.
steps.check: 圖例應能一眼分辨三種功能與兩種橫向連接。
steps.checkEn: The key must distinguish the three functions and the two types of lateral connection.

knowledge.title: 功能隔離
knowledge.text: 中央服務隧道提供維護與緊急支援，與行車隧道用途不同。
knowledge.textEn: The central service tunnel supports maintenance and emergencies rather than normal rail traffic.

knowledge.title: 連接類型
knowledge.text: 聯絡通道服務人員移動；橫渡洞室則提供列車跨線能力。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-passages support movement of people; crossover caverns allow trains to change running tunnels.

options: 設有軌道的橫渡洞室
一般人行聯絡通道
服務隧道內的排水溝
optionsEn: A rail crossover cavern
An ordinary pedestrian cross-passage
A service-tunnel drain
quiz.question: 需要列車從一條行車隧道移到另一條時，對應哪個構造？
quiz.questionEn: Which structure allows a train to change from one running tunnel to the other?
quiz.explanation: 不同橫向連接有不同尺寸和用途，不能在系統圖上混用。
quiz.explanationEn: Different lateral connections serve different functions and must not be conflated.

steps.title: 讀懂服務隧道壓差概念
steps.objective: 理解保護空間與門、通風的相互依賴。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand dependencies among protected space, doors and ventilation.
steps.instruction: 以兩個箱體代表服務與行車隧道，畫出正常示意氣流和門開啟時的可能路徑。列出判斷氣流方向需要的資料，不自行設定火災排煙程序。
steps.instructionEn: Represent service and running tunnels as two boxes. Sketch intended airflow and possible paths when a door opens. List data needed to judge flow without defining fire-smoke operating procedures.
steps.observation: 注意風機狀態、壓差與門的位置並非同一個訊號。
steps.observationEn: Fan status, pressure difference and door position are different signals.
steps.failure: 只因風機顯示開啟，就認定保護空間一定維持壓差。
steps.failureEn: Assuming a protected space maintains pressure simply because a fan indicates running.
steps.check: 列出至少三個互相核對的狀態或觀察量。
steps.checkEn: List at least three states or observations to cross-check.

knowledge.title: 壓差屏障
knowledge.text: 適當的壓差可引導氣流；實際效果仍受開口與系統狀態影響。
knowledge.textEn: Pressure differences can direct flow; openings and system state affect actual performance.

knowledge.title: 功能驗證
knowledge.text: 設備運转訊號只能證明部分狀態，不能代替完整功能證據。
knowledge.textEn: A running indication establishes only part of the state, not complete functional performance.

options: 忽略壓差，因馬達已運轉
核對開口、氣流及感測狀態
立即認定所有門都關妥
optionsEn: Ignore pressure because motors are running
Check openings, airflow and sensor state
Assume all doors are properly closed
quiz.question: 風機開啟但保護區壓差不足，哪個判斷較合理？
quiz.questionEn: Fans run but protected-zone pressure is insufficient. Which judgment is sound?
quiz.explanation: 保護功能依賴整體狀態，必須把設備與環境證據合看。
quiz.explanationEn: Protection depends on system state, so equipment and environmental evidence must be combined.

stages.title: 襯砌與三隧道介面
stages.description: 追蹤環片接合、排水與聯絡通道在不同狀態的功能。
stages.descriptionEn: Trace segment joints, drainage and cross-passages under different system states.

steps.title: 整理軌道與機電淨空
steps.objective: 看出斷面配置中的安裝與維護衝突。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify installation and maintenance conflicts in a cross-section.
steps.instruction: 在自繪圓形斷面放入列車包絡、步道、電車線、冷卻管與電纜。再畫一個設備維護所需空間，以虛線標記尚無尺寸資料的部分。
steps.instructionEn: Place a train envelope, walkway, catenary, cooling pipes and cables in a circular sketch. Add maintenance space and use dashed boundaries where dimensional evidence is missing.
steps.observation: 比較「裝得下」與「仍可檢查、撤離和維護」是否不同。
steps.observationEn: Distinguish physical fit from retained inspection, egress and maintenance access.
steps.failure: 只畫設備外形，忽略人員通行及拆換路徑。
steps.failureEn: Drawing equipment outlines without access or replacement paths.
steps.check: 找出兩個潛在介面衝突並列明需向哪個專業取得資料。
steps.checkEn: Identify two potential conflicts and the disciplines that must provide missing data.

knowledge.title: 包絡介面
knowledge.text: 設備配置須同時考慮車輛動態、結構和通行空間。
knowledge.textEn: Equipment layout must account for vehicle motion, structure and access together.

knowledge.title: 維護空間
knowledge.text: 正常運轉不碰撞，不等於能安全拆換或檢查設備。
knowledge.textEn: Collision-free operation does not establish that equipment can be inspected or replaced safely.

options: 是，唯一條件是不碰列車
只要管線顏色不同即可
尚未，通行與維護需求仍未滿足
optionsEn: Yes; avoiding the train is the only condition
Yes, if the pipe has a different color
No; access and maintenance requirements remain unresolved
quiz.question: 一條新管線不碰列車但占用步道，是否已完成介面檢核？
quiz.questionEn: A new pipe avoids the train but occupies the walkway. Is interface review complete?
quiz.explanation: 斷面有多種功能包絡，不能只檢查車輛外形。
quiz.explanationEn: The cross-section contains multiple functional envelopes, not only a train outline.

steps.title: 檢查供電與服務依賴
steps.objective: 說明冗餘電源不等於所有設備都無中斷。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain why redundant supplies do not prove uninterrupted service for every load.
steps.instruction: 畫出兩岸電源、供電分段及列車、排水、照明三類負載。以紙上情境移除一個來源，標記哪些功能仍需切換與控制證據。
steps.instructionEn: Diagram power from both shores, supply sections and train, drainage and lighting loads. Remove one source in a paper scenario and mark functions requiring transfer and control evidence.
steps.observation: 比較電源存在、路徑可用與末端設備運轉三種狀態。
steps.observationEn: Distinguish source availability, path availability and operation of the final device.
steps.failure: 把圖上有兩個電源直接視為所有故障情況都有備援。
steps.failureEn: Treating two drawn power sources as proof of redundancy for every failure case.
steps.check: 為一個負載畫出完整替代路徑，並列一個共同失效點的疑問。
steps.checkEn: Trace an alternative path to one load and identify a possible common failure point.

knowledge.title: 端到端功能
knowledge.text: 備援需要從來源到負載的完整可用路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Redundancy requires a complete available path from source to load.

knowledge.title: 共同依賴
knowledge.text: 兩條供電路徑仍可能共用控制、保護或連接設備。
knowledge.textEn: Two supply paths may still share control, protection or connection equipment.

options: 替代來源到排水設備的整條路徑是否可用
只核對備援來源額定容量，不追蹤配電路徑
以其他負載正常推論排水設備必定可用
optionsEn: Is the complete alternative path to drainage equipment available?
Check backup source rating without tracing distribution
Infer drainage availability because other loads work
quiz.question: 確認排水備援時，哪個問題最重要？
quiz.questionEn: Which question matters most when verifying drainage backup?
quiz.explanation: 功能驗證必須追到負載，不能停在上游電源。
quiz.explanationEn: Verification must reach the load rather than stop at the upstream source.

steps.title: 組織維護占用與復歸證據
steps.titleEn: Organize maintenance possession and return evidence
steps.objective: 辨認施工完成與恢復運行間的交接責任。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish completion of work from authorization to resume service.
steps.instruction: 建立示意交接表，含區段、受影響設備、隔離狀態、檢查結果及未結案項。用「換線維護」桌上情境辨認交通與設備團隊的交界，不模擬真實控制指令。
steps.instructionEn: Build an illustrative handover sheet with section, affected equipment, isolation state, checks and open items. Use a crossover-maintenance tabletop scenario to identify team interfaces without simulating real control commands.
steps.observation: 觀察工件安裝完成是否仍有功能測試與文件核對未完成。
steps.observationEn: Notice whether physical completion still leaves functional tests or document reconciliation pending.
steps.failure: 以工時結束代替設備復歸與路線交接確認。
steps.failureEn: Treating the end of a work shift as confirmation of equipment restoration and route handover.
steps.check: 將施工完成、測試完成與授權狀態分成獨立欄位。
steps.checkEn: Keep work completion, test completion and authorization state in separate fields.

knowledge.title: 狀態交接
knowledge.text: 跨班或跨專業交接應描述實際設備狀態及尚未解除的限制。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-shift or cross-discipline handover must describe actual equipment state and remaining restrictions.

knowledge.title: 責任邊界
knowledge.text: 驗證證據與運行授權由不同角色承擔時，介面必須清楚。
knowledge.textEn: Interfaces must be explicit when verification and operating authority belong to different roles.

options: 直接填寫已全面復歸
機械完成與功能未驗證分別列示
刪除測試欄以免混淆
optionsEn: Mark fully restored
Record mechanical completion and unverified function separately
Remove the test field
quiz.question: 工件已裝回但功能測試未完成，交接表應如何表示？
quiz.questionEn: A component is reinstalled but functional testing is incomplete. How should it be recorded?
quiz.explanation: 不同完成層次不能互相替代，否則會掩蓋未結案工作。
quiz.explanationEn: Different completion levels are not interchangeable and must not hide unfinished work.

steps.title: 交付三隧道整合模型
steps.objective: 將土建與機電證據連成可查核的系統。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect civil and service-system evidence into an auditable model.
steps.instruction: 把地質、襯砌、漏水、通風和供電圖表整理成同一介面索引。選一個「供電中斷伴隨滲水」假想情境，指出需聯合查證的兩個系統與資料缺口。
steps.instructionEn: Index ground, lining, ingress, ventilation and power records together. For an invented power-loss-plus-ingress scenario, identify two systems requiring joint review and remaining evidence gaps.
steps.observation: 檢查每個功能主張是否有可定位的圖表或紀錄支持。
steps.observationEn: Check that each functional claim has a located diagram or record behind it.
steps.failure: 各專業圖表單獨完整，卻無法對齊區段名稱與狀態。
steps.failureEn: Individually complete discipline records cannot be reconciled by location or state.
steps.check: 提交共享區段索引、假設清單與至少三項未解介面問題。
steps.checkEn: Submit a common section index, assumptions and at least three unresolved interface questions.

knowledge.title: 系統整合
knowledge.text: 隧道能否服務取決於土建、設備、交通與維護的共同狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Tunnel service depends on combined civil, equipment, traffic and maintenance states.

knowledge.title: 共同識別
knowledge.text: 一致的區段與設備識別可防止把不同位置的證據錯接。
knowledge.textEn: Consistent section and equipment identifiers prevent mismatching evidence from different locations.

options: 只核對總設備數量是否相同
只比較各自最後一次正常結果
區段、設備識別、時間及狀態
optionsEn: Whether total equipment counts match
Compare only each system’s latest normal result
Section, equipment identity, time and state
quiz.question: 整合兩份排水與供電紀錄前，最先應核對什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What should first be reconciled when integrating drainage and power records?
quiz.explanation: 共同識別與時間狀態使不同專業證據可以正確連結。
quiz.explanationEn: Shared identifiers and time/state information allow evidence from different disciplines to be connected correctly.

stages.title: 機電整合與交付
stages.description: 以桌上情境檢查通風、供電、交通和維護的依賴。
stages.descriptionEn: Use tabletop scenarios to review dependencies among ventilation, power, traffic and maintenance.

courses.title: 英法海底隧道
courses.summary: 從白堊泥灰岩選線到三隧道營運系統，練習地質推論、支承、防水與機電整合。
courses.summaryEn: Study geological inference, support, water control and systems integration from chalk-marl alignment to three-bore operation.
courses.scope: 以公開資料建立的原創教學分解；所有步驟為紙上、數位模型與證據判讀練習。自繪的示意與自設資料必須標示假設；本站未提供現地工程資料，亦不是核准施工、設備操作或水質放行程序。
courses.scopeEn: Original educational decomposition of public information. Every step is a paper, digital-model or evidence-interpretation exercise. Label assumptions in self-drawn diagrams and invented data; this site does not supply field engineering records or approved construction, operating or water-release procedures.

steps.title: 分開水庫、壩體與洩流路徑
steps.titleEn: Separate reservoir, dam and release paths
steps.objective: 分辨擋水、蓄水、發電和溢洪功能。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish retention, storage, generation and spillway functions.
steps.instruction: 自繪水庫、壩體、進水塔、壓力管、電廠及兩側溢洪路徑。以不同線型追蹤發電水路與溢洪水路到下游，標出它們與壩體的介面。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch reservoir, dam, intake towers, penstocks, powerhouse and side spillways. Trace generation and spillway routes to downstream using distinct line styles and mark dam interfaces.
steps.observation: 確認溢洪水路並非越過壩頂流向電廠。
steps.observationEn: Confirm that the spillway route does not pass over the dam crest onto the powerhouse.
steps.failure: 將所有放流水都畫成穿過水輪機，忽略獨立洩流功能。
steps.failureEn: Drawing all released water through turbines and overlooking separate release functions.
steps.check: 圖中須有兩條可獨立追蹤的水路及各自功能。
steps.checkEn: Show two independently traceable water routes and their functions.

knowledge.title: 功能分流
knowledge.text: 蓄水結構與不同出流路徑共同構成水庫系統。
knowledge.textEn: The retaining structure and different outlet routes jointly form the reservoir system.

knowledge.title: 介面辨識
knowledge.text: 進水、管路、發電與下游水流的交界需要清楚定義。
knowledge.textEn: Interfaces among intakes, conduits, generation and downstream flow need clear definitions.

options: 溢洪道
水輪機壓力管，所有溢洪都必須經過它
壩頂道路，作為預定水流越頂路徑
optionsEn: Spillway
Turbine penstocks, which all spill flow must use
The crest road as the intended overtopping route
quiz.question: 哪個構造最直接提供與發電水路分開的高水位洩流途徑？
quiz.questionEn: Which structure most directly provides a high-water release path separate from generation?
quiz.explanation: 溢洪系統有獨立的水流路徑，不能以水輪機水路代替。
quiz.explanationEn: The spillway has its own hydraulic path and cannot be represented by the turbine route.

steps.title: 追蹤拱壩與重力作用
steps.objective: 解釋壩體、基底與兩岸岩體如何共同受力。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain joint load transfer through dam body, base and canyon rock.
steps.instruction: 畫平面與剖面兩張示意：平面標水壓與向兩岸傳力，剖面標自重、基底及水壓。註明這是厚拱壩的定性模型，不能用箭頭直接判定安全。
steps.instructionEn: Draw plan and section: show pressure and transfer toward abutments in plan, then weight, base and water pressure in section. Label this a qualitative thick-arch model, not a safety calculation.
steps.observation: 觀察只畫剖面是否會遺漏兩岸岩體的作用。
steps.observationEn: Notice what abutment action is lost when only a section is drawn.
steps.failure: 將壩的全部抵抗能力只歸因於重量或只歸因於拱形。
steps.failureEn: Attributing all resistance solely to weight or solely to curvature.
steps.check: 兩張圖應共同包含水、壩體、基底和兩岸的力路徑。
steps.checkEn: Together, the sketches must include water, dam, base and abutment force paths.

knowledge.title: 三維受力
knowledge.text: 厚拱壩的行為需同時考慮壩體與岩體支承，單一剖面不完整。
knowledge.textEn: A thick arch dam requires consideration of dam and rock support; one section is incomplete.

knowledge.title: 邊界可靠性
knowledge.text: 理想模型假設的支承能力需要地質與變形證據支持。
knowledge.textEn: Support capacity assumed in an ideal model needs geological and deformation evidence.

options: 兩岸只限制滲水，不參與傳力
拱作用把部分荷載傳入兩岸
拱形會使地基完全不受力
optionsEn: Abutments only limit seepage and carry no structural load
Arch action transfers part of the load into the abutments
Curvature makes the foundation entirely unloaded
quiz.question: 兩岸岩體的條件為何影響拱作用判讀？
quiz.questionEn: Why do abutment-rock conditions matter for arch action?
quiz.explanation: 受力路徑需要能承接反力的岩體邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: The load path needs rock boundaries capable of providing reactions.

steps.title: 重建導流與乾地作業依賴
steps.objective: 理解臨時導流如何提供永久工程的作業條件。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand how temporary diversion enables permanent works.
steps.instruction: 依歷史資料畫出原河道、導流隧道與壩基作業區。用三格示意比較導流前、導流中和永久水路形成後，記錄每格水流去向。
steps.instructionEn: From historical accounts, sketch the river, diversion tunnels and foundation work area. Compare pre-diversion, diversion and permanent-waterway states, recording the flow destination in each.
steps.observation: 檢查某一格是否意外把所有流路同時關閉。
steps.observationEn: Check whether a state inadvertently closes every flow route.
steps.failure: 把圍堰視為不受來水影響的永久邊界，省略施工期洪水疑問。
steps.failureEn: Treating cofferdams as permanent, flow-independent boundaries and omitting construction-flood questions.
steps.check: 每一格都保留連續水路及尚待專業分析的施工期風險。
steps.checkEn: Preserve a continuous water route and a construction-risk question in each state.

knowledge.title: 臨時工程
knowledge.text: 臨時設施的功能與失效會直接影響永久工程的施工條件。
knowledge.textEn: Temporary-work functions and failures directly affect conditions for permanent construction.

knowledge.title: 狀態轉換
knowledge.text: 由導流到蓄水是系統邊界的變更，需要另行驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Transition from diversion to impoundment changes system boundaries and needs separate verification.

options: 尚未列出最後一台發電機的安裝日期
沒有先列出永久工程總材料量
某階段沒有說明來水可往何處流
optionsEn: The last generator’s installation date is not yet given
Permanent-work material totals are not listed first
A stage gives no destination for incoming water
quiz.question: 在導流轉換圖中最嚴重的缺漏是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What is the most significant omission in a diversion-transition diagram?
quiz.explanation: 轉換階段仍須追蹤水流，不能因圖是中間狀態就忽略。
quiz.explanationEn: Flow must remain accounted for even during an intermediate state.

steps.title: 整理壩基與裂隙證據
steps.objective: 分開岩石材料、接觸面與滲流路徑問題。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate rock-material, contact and seepage-path questions.
steps.instruction: 在假想基岩剖面標記裂隙、壩基接觸面、排水與觀測位置。建立「材料強度」「接面狀態」「水壓」三欄，為每欄列出不同證據。
steps.instructionEn: On an invented rock section, mark discontinuities, dam contact, drains and observations. Create separate material-strength, contact-condition and water-pressure columns with distinct evidence needs.
steps.observation: 注意堅硬岩石仍可能包含需要調查的裂隙與水路。
steps.observationEn: Recognize that strong rock may still contain discontinuities and water paths needing investigation.
steps.failure: 只用岩石名稱或表面硬度，就認定壩基介面完整。
steps.failureEn: Declaring the foundation interface sound from rock name or surface hardness alone.
steps.check: 三欄均須有觀察量與至少一項無法單獨推論的結論。
steps.checkEn: Give an observable and a conclusion it cannot establish alone in each column.

knowledge.title: 岩體與岩塊
knowledge.text: 岩塊性質不能完整代表含裂隙岩體的行為。
knowledge.textEn: Intact-rock properties do not fully describe a fractured rock mass.

knowledge.title: 水壓與接觸
knowledge.text: 滲流條件會影響接觸面的有效受力，需與結構資料一起判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Seepage conditions affect effective contact loading and must be interpreted with structural evidence.

options: 該試體在試驗條件下的材料表現
整個壩基所有裂隙均不透水
任何水位下都不需監測
optionsEn: Material behavior of that specimen under test conditions
Every foundation discontinuity is watertight
Monitoring is unnecessary at any reservoir level
quiz.question: 完整岩心強度良好，可直接證明什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Good intact-core strength directly establishes what?
quiz.explanation: 試體證據有取樣與尺度範圍，不能無條件推廣到整個岩體。
quiz.explanationEn: Specimen evidence has sampling and scale limits and cannot automatically represent the whole rock mass.

stages.title: 河谷與施工邊界
stages.description: 分清永久工程的受力、水路與臨時導流。
stages.descriptionEn: Distinguish permanent load paths, water routes and temporary diversion.

steps.title: 閱讀分塊澆置的介面
steps.objective: 辨認分塊施工與最終整體作用的差別。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish block construction from final integrated behavior.
steps.instruction: 把壩體畫成少量教學用方塊，標記不同完成高度與接縫。比較「單塊已有強度」和「相鄰區塊已形成設計傳力」兩種判斷所需的證據。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a few educational dam blocks with unequal completion heights and joints. Compare evidence for one block gaining strength with evidence for intended transfer between adjacent blocks.
steps.observation: 觀察接縫狀態改變時，整體模型的連續性假設也需變更。
steps.observationEn: Notice how joint-state changes alter assumptions about structural continuity.
steps.failure: 因所有塊體都已澆完，就視為接縫與整體作用自動完成。
steps.failureEn: Assuming joints and integrated action are complete because all blocks have been poured.
steps.check: 標記每個示意接縫的狀態與尚缺驗證，避免填施工尺寸。
steps.checkEn: Mark each joint state and missing verification without assigning construction dimensions.

knowledge.title: 分塊邏輯
knowledge.text: 分塊可管理施工與熱行為；最終整體作用仍須處理接縫。
knowledge.textEn: Blocks organize construction and thermal behavior; final integrated action still depends on joints.

knowledge.title: 狀態紀錄
knowledge.text: 施工紀錄須能說明各區塊在同一時間的實際成熟與接合狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Records should identify each block’s maturity and connection state at a common time.

options: 以最後澆置日期代替所有接合驗證
接縫處理與整體傳力條件
以各塊外觀完整代替整體作用查證
optionsEn: Use the last pour date in place of all joint verification
Joint treatment and conditions for integrated load transfer
Use intact block appearance as proof of integrated action
quiz.question: 所有壩塊已澆置，哪項仍須單獨查證？
quiz.questionEn: All blocks are poured. What still requires independent verification?
quiz.explanation: 材料放置完成不等於所有介面功能完成。
quiz.explanationEn: Completion of material placement does not establish completion of every interface function.

steps.title: 比較水化熱與冷卻歷程
steps.titleEn: Compare hydration heat and cooling histories
steps.objective: 理解溫度梯度、收縮與裂縫的關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand relationships among thermal gradients, contraction and cracking.
steps.instruction: 自繪混凝土核心與表面兩條溫度—時間曲線，再畫冷卻較快的比較曲線。標記水化放熱、散熱及相對收縮，不採用歷史設備數值作今日設定。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch core and surface temperature histories and a faster-cooling comparison. Mark hydration heat, heat loss and relative contraction without using historical equipment values as present settings.
steps.observation: 比較最高溫相近但內外溫差不同的情況。
steps.observationEn: Compare cases with similar peak temperature but different internal-to-surface gradients.
steps.failure: 把快速降溫一概當作越快越好，忽略拘束與梯度。
steps.failureEn: Assuming faster cooling is always better while ignoring restraint and gradients.
steps.check: 解釋為何峰值、梯度與時間歷程都需保留。
steps.checkEn: Explain why peak, gradient and time history all need to be retained.

knowledge.title: 熱源與尺度
knowledge.text: 大體積混凝土的內部熱不易迅速逸散，溫度分布會不均勻。
knowledge.textEn: Heat within mass concrete does not escape quickly, producing nonuniform temperatures.

knowledge.title: 拘束收縮
knowledge.text: 自由收縮受到相鄰材料或幾何拘束時，可能產生應力。
knowledge.textEn: Contraction restrained by adjacent material or geometry can generate stress.

options: 是，最高溫是唯一需要的資料
只需表面溫度相同即可認定等效
不一定，梯度、拘束與材料歷程也影響結果
optionsEn: Yes; peak temperature is the only relevant data
Equal surface temperature alone establishes equivalence
No; gradients, restraint and material history also matter
quiz.question: 相同最高溫的兩塊混凝土，裂縫風險必定相同嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Do two concrete blocks with the same peak temperature necessarily share cracking risk?
quiz.explanation: 最高溫只描述熱歷程的一部分，無法取代梯度和拘束證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Peak temperature captures only part of thermal history and cannot replace gradient and restraint evidence.

steps.title: 分清接縫灌漿與排水
steps.objective: 避免把填充接縫與降低滲流水壓混成同一功能。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid conflating joint filling with management of seepage pressure.
steps.instruction: 在兩張小圖分別畫壩塊接縫與壩基排水路徑。用功能敘述解釋灌漿、止水與排水各想改變什麼，再列出需查證的效果。
steps.instructionEn: Draw block joints and foundation drainage in separate sketches. Explain what grouting, water barriers and drainage seek to change, then identify evidence of their effects.
steps.observation: 觀察流量減少是否同時需要查看水壓，而非單獨判為改善。
steps.observationEn: Check whether reduced flow also requires pressure data before it is called an improvement.
steps.failure: 把排水孔流量變小直接認定為止水良好，忽略可能堵塞。
steps.failureEn: Treating falling drain flow as proof of improved water exclusion while overlooking possible blockage.
steps.check: 提交功能對照與一組「流量下降」的兩種替代解釋。
steps.checkEn: Provide a function comparison and two alternative explanations for falling flow.

knowledge.title: 功能區別
knowledge.text: 填充或接合、限制入流與引導排水，是不同工程功能。
knowledge.textEn: Filling or joining, limiting ingress and conveying drainage are different engineering functions.

knowledge.title: 組合證據
knowledge.text: 流量與壓力一起看，比只看其中一項更能限制錯誤推論。
knowledge.textEn: Flow and pressure considered together constrain interpretations better than either alone.

options: 排水路徑受阻等替代原因
整體止水效果必然變好
只增加流量讀數次數，忽略壓力上升
optionsEn: Alternative causes such as obstructed drainage
Water exclusion has necessarily improved
Repeat flow readings while ignoring rising pressure
quiz.question: 排水流量下降而附近水壓升高，應優先考慮什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Drain flow falls while nearby water pressure rises. What warrants consideration?
quiz.explanation: 相反的水壓與流量趨勢不能只解讀為漏水減少。
quiz.explanationEn: Opposing pressure and flow trends cannot be interpreted solely as reduced leakage.

steps.title: 連結進水、管路與水輪機
steps.titleEn: Link intake, conduit and turbine interfaces
steps.objective: 辨識高程差、流量與瞬變的不同問題。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish head, flow and transient-response questions.
steps.instruction: 自繪水面、進水口、壓力管和水輪機的高程關係。用兩格比較穩定流動與流量改變的概念，註明沒有進行真實閥門操作或壓力計算。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch elevations of reservoir surface, intake, penstock and turbine. Compare steady flow and changing flow in two panels, explicitly excluding real valve operation or pressure calculations.
steps.observation: 注意管路不是只把水運送到機組，也承受壓力與約束反力。
steps.observationEn: A conduit transports water while also carrying pressure and restraint forces.
steps.failure: 只用高程差估算發電概念，就宣稱已驗證管路所有受力。
steps.failureEn: Claiming complete conduit verification from an elevation-based generation estimate alone.
steps.check: 列出穩態與瞬變各需的資料，並保留未知邊界條件。
steps.checkEn: List data needed for steady and transient states, keeping unknown boundary conditions explicit.

knowledge.title: 能量路徑
knowledge.text: 水位差提供能量潛力；實際輸出還受流量與損失影響。
knowledge.textEn: Water-level difference provides energy potential; output also depends on flow and losses.

knowledge.title: 瞬變效應
knowledge.text: 流速改變會引起隨時間變化的壓力，不能只用穩態圖描述。
knowledge.textEn: Changing velocity produces time-varying pressure that a steady-state diagram cannot fully describe.

options: 穩態平均壓力必定等於所有瞬時峰值
流量變化可能造成動態壓力反應
只要高程不變，壓力就不可能隨時間變化
optionsEn: Steady mean pressure necessarily equals every transient peak
Changing flow can create a dynamic pressure response
If elevation stays fixed, pressure cannot change with time
quiz.question: 為何穩態壓力資料不能單獨代表快速流量變化時的狀態？
quiz.questionEn: Why cannot steady pressure alone represent a rapid flow change?
quiz.explanation: 瞬變是時間相關的系統反應，需要額外的模型及資料。
quiz.explanationEn: A transient is a time-dependent system response requiring additional modeling and evidence.

stages.title: 壩體與水工介面
stages.description: 追蹤分塊、熱變形、接縫與管路的相互影響。
stages.descriptionEn: Trace interactions among blocks, thermal movement, joints and conduits.

steps.title: 從溢洪道侵蝕追查水流
steps.titleEn: Trace spillway erosion to flow behavior
steps.objective: 區分看到的損傷與尚未確定的侵蝕機制。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate observed damage from an unconfirmed erosion mechanism.
steps.instruction: 依歷史案例自繪溢洪道至斜隧道的路徑，在一處標示假想侵蝕。列出流路幾何、接縫、流量歷程與表面調查等需查證資料，不直接指定修補材料。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch the historical spillway-to-inclined-tunnel path and mark hypothetical erosion. List geometry, joints, flow history and surface evidence to investigate without prescribing repair materials.
steps.observation: 比較同樣「混凝土缺損」可能具有不同位置、發展速度及成因。
steps.observationEn: Similar concrete loss may differ in location, growth rate and cause.
steps.failure: 看見侵蝕就套用單一成因，或把修補完成當成成因已排除。
steps.failureEn: Assigning one cause from appearance or treating a completed repair as proof the cause is removed.
steps.check: 建立損傷地圖，明確分出已觀察事實與待驗證機制。
steps.checkEn: Create a damage map distinguishing observed facts from mechanisms requiring verification.

knowledge.title: 水工損傷
knowledge.text: 高速水流與局部幾何可能形成複雜作用；外觀不足以單獨辨因。
knowledge.textEn: High-speed flow and local geometry can interact in complex ways; appearance alone is insufficient for diagnosis.

knowledge.title: 歷史回饋
knowledge.text: 既有侵蝕與修復紀錄提供檢查重點，但不能直接代替新事件調查。
knowledge.textEn: Historical erosion and repairs guide inspection but do not replace investigation of a new event.

options: 只核對修補材料強度，不檢查流路
沿用前次成因，不核對本次事件條件
事件流量歷程、幾何和局部表面狀態
optionsEn: Check repair strength without examining the water route
Reuse the previous diagnosis without checking this event
Event flow history, geometry and local surface conditions
quiz.question: 修補區再次出現侵蝕，最應補查哪類證據？
quiz.questionEn: Erosion reappears near a repair. What evidence most needs review?
quiz.explanation: 反覆損傷需要回到水流與局部介面的機制，而非只記錄修補外觀。
quiz.explanationEn: Repeated damage requires review of flow and interface mechanisms, not only repaired appearance.

steps.title: 建立壩體監測比較窗
steps.objective: 把水位、溫度與變形的時間關係分開。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate time relationships among reservoir level, temperature and deformation.
steps.instruction: 自行製作六列示例水位、氣溫、位移與排水紀錄，標記季節性變化。挑出兩組相近條件資料，比較剩餘差異並保留儀器核對欄。
steps.instructionEn: Invent six records of reservoir level, temperature, movement and drainage, marking seasonal variation. Compare two matched-condition groups and retain an instrument-check field.
steps.observation: 觀察同一位移數字可能對應不同水位或溫度狀態。
steps.observationEn: The same displacement value may occur under different water-level or temperature conditions.
steps.failure: 把正常環境循環或感測器零點變更直接當成永久損傷。
steps.failureEn: Treating environmental cycles or sensor-zero changes as permanent damage.
steps.check: 為一個異常保留環境、儀器與結構三種可能解釋。
steps.checkEn: Retain environmental, instrument and structural explanations for one anomaly.

knowledge.title: 條件化比較
knowledge.text: 跨時比較應記錄荷載與環境，避免將不同條件混成趨勢。
knowledge.textEn: Comparisons over time should retain load and environment rather than merge different conditions into one trend.

knowledge.title: 證據交叉核對
knowledge.text: 位移、滲流和目視紀錄各有盲點，組合使用有助限制誤判。
knowledge.textEn: Movement, seepage and visual records have different blind spots; combining them limits misinterpretation.

options: 有需要進一步檢驗的相關性
已證明全部由溫度造成
已證明壩體永久失效
optionsEn: A correlation requiring further examination
Temperature has been proven the sole cause
Permanent dam failure has been proven
quiz.question: 位移季節性變化與氣溫同步，能直接推論什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Displacement varies seasonally with temperature. What can be inferred directly?
quiz.explanation: 同步變化是線索，並非單獨的因果或安全證明。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronous variation is a clue, not standalone causal or safety proof.

steps.title: 做有邊界的水量收支
steps.objective: 區分蓄水變化與不同出流用途。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish storage change from different outflow uses.
steps.instruction: 自設一個單日水量例子，列入入流、放流、蒸發與蓄水變化。再畫兩個不同放流分配的教學情境，只比較質量守恆，不提出真實調度建議。
steps.instructionEn: Invent a one-day example with inflow, release, evaporation and storage change. Compare two illustrative release allocations for mass balance only, without recommending real reservoir operations.
steps.observation: 檢查發電流量與總放流是否被重複計入。
steps.observationEn: Check whether generation flow is double-counted within total release.
steps.failure: 將通過水輪機的水當成消失，或忽略水庫蓄積。
steps.failureEn: Treating turbine flow as consumed water or omitting storage change.
steps.check: 收支需閉合，並標明全部數字是自設例子及尚缺用途限制。
steps.checkEn: Close the balance and label all numbers as invented, with unmodeled use constraints.

knowledge.title: 守恆邊界
knowledge.text: 在選定空間與時間內，水量入出與蓄積必須一致。
knowledge.textEn: Within defined space and time, inflow, outflow and storage must balance.

knowledge.title: 多重目標
knowledge.text: 供水、發電、洪水與環境問題不會被單一水量平衡自動解決。
knowledge.textEn: A water balance alone does not resolve supply, energy, flood and environmental objectives.

options: 同時列為兩次出流
作為出流，不再另列一次消耗
從所有收支欄刪除
optionsEn: As two separate outflows
As outflow, without counting a second consumption
Omit it from the balance
quiz.question: 水流經水輪機後到達下游，在水庫收支中應如何處理？
quiz.questionEn: Water passes through turbines to downstream. How is it represented in the reservoir balance?
quiz.explanation: 同一水量不能因用途名稱不同而重複計算。
quiz.explanationEn: The same water must not be counted twice because it has different use labels.

steps.title: 編成壩工證據與限制清單
steps.objective: 交付能區分歷史案例、模型與實測需求的資料。
steps.objectiveEn: Deliver records distinguishing historical cases, models and measurement needs.
steps.instruction: 整理水路圖、受力圖、施工狀態、熱曲線與監測表。為每項結論註記它屬歷史事實、教學假設或仍需實測，並列出專業複核邊界。
steps.instructionEn: Organize route, force, construction-state, thermal and monitoring records. Label each conclusion as historical fact, educational assumption or needing measurement, and identify professional-review boundaries.
steps.observation: 核對舊施工記錄是否被誤寫成現行通用規格。
steps.observationEn: Check whether a historical construction record has been misrepresented as a current universal specification.
steps.failure: 把課程示意數值寫入真實施工、設備或放流水量設定。
steps.failureEn: Transferring illustrative course values into actual construction, equipment or release settings.
steps.check: 至少五項判斷可回查到來源或自設假設，未解問題單獨列出。
steps.checkEn: Make at least five conclusions traceable to sources or declared assumptions, with open issues listed separately.

knowledge.title: 歷史與規範
knowledge.text: 歷史工程能提供思考案例，但今日設計需另外的資料與程序。
knowledge.textEn: Historical engineering provides cases for reasoning; present design requires additional evidence and procedures.

knowledge.title: 範圍宣告
knowledge.text: 證據能支持什麼及不能支持什麼，都應出現在交付中。
knowledge.textEn: A handover should state both what evidence supports and what it does not.

options: 已完成課程，所以真壩可按此圖操作
歷史數字可直接套用任何新壩
本模型展示功能與依賴，尚非壩體安全鑑定
optionsEn: Course completion authorizes operation from this sketch
Historical values apply directly to any new dam
This model shows functions and dependencies, not a dam-safety assessment
quiz.question: 哪項交付敘述最合適？
quiz.questionEn: Which handover statement is most appropriate?
quiz.explanation: 學習模型的可審查性不等於真實工程驗證完成。
quiz.explanationEn: A reviewable learning model is not completed validation of a real engineering system.

stages.title: 洩流與長期判讀
stages.description: 以侵蝕、監測與水量證據檢查工程的運作邊界。
stages.descriptionEn: Review operating boundaries using erosion, monitoring and water-balance evidence.

courses.title: 胡佛壩
courses.summary: 以導流、大體積混凝土、壩基及洩流系統理解大型壩工的工序依賴與證據。
courses.summaryEn: Understand dependencies and evidence in large-dam engineering through diversion, mass concrete, foundations and water-release systems.
courses.scope: 以公開資料建立的原創教學分解；所有步驟為紙上、數位模型與證據判讀練習。自繪的示意與自設資料必須標示假設；本站未提供現地工程資料，亦不是核准施工、設備操作或水質放行程序。
courses.scopeEn: Original educational decomposition of public information. Every step is a paper, digital-model or evidence-interpretation exercise. Label assumptions in self-drawn diagrams and invented data; this site does not supply field engineering records or approved construction, operating or water-release procedures.

steps.title: 建立高鐵系統邊界
steps.objective: 分開土建、軌道、供電、車輛、控制及營運介面。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate civil, track, power, vehicle, control and operations interfaces.
steps.instruction: 畫出土建承托軌道、軌道導引車輛的主鏈，再加供電與控制連到車輛。以不同箭頭表示力、能量與資訊，為每種介面列一項驗證問題。
steps.instructionEn: Draw civil support to track to vehicle, then connect power and control to the vehicle. Use distinct arrows for force, energy and information, with one verification question per interface.
steps.observation: 觀察車輛能運轉是否仍不足以證明軌道與控制整合已完成。
steps.observationEn: Recognize that a moving train alone does not establish completed track and control integration.
steps.failure: 把高鐵等同於一列高速列車，省略路線與控制條件。
steps.failureEn: Equating a high-speed railway with a fast train while omitting route and control conditions.
steps.check: 六個子系統都有介面，且箭頭的物理意義清楚。
steps.checkEn: Connect all six subsystems and explain the physical meaning of each arrow.

knowledge.title: 跨專業系統
knowledge.text: 高速運行取決於車輛與路線、供電、控制及營運的一致性。
knowledge.textEn: High-speed operation depends on compatibility among vehicles, route, power, control and operations.

knowledge.title: 不同傳遞量
knowledge.text: 力、電能與控制資訊需要不同驗證，不能用同一箭頭含糊表示。
knowledge.textEn: Force, electrical energy and control information require different verification and should not share an ambiguous arrow.

options: 與路線動態及控制系統相容
列車靜態寬度已被量測
尺寸文件有可比對的幾何內容
optionsEn: Compatibility with route dynamics and control
That static train width was measured
That the dimensional record contains comparable geometry
quiz.question: 列車靜態尺寸合格，還不能單獨證明哪件事？
quiz.questionEn: A train meets static dimensional requirements. What does that not establish by itself?
quiz.explanation: 靜態幾何只是整合條件的一部分，仍需動態與控制證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Static geometry is only part of integration; dynamic and control evidence remains necessary.

steps.title: 比較曲線與行車需求
steps.titleEn: Compare alignment curves and service needs
steps.objective: 理解速度、曲線與舒適性的相互約束。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand relationships among speed, curvature and ride requirements.
steps.instruction: 自繪直線、緩和曲線與圓曲線的概念路線，標出方向變化。比較兩種示意速度下需要關注的橫向反應，不指定實線設計半徑或超高。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch straight, transition and circular alignment sections, marking direction changes. Compare lateral-response concerns at two illustrative speeds without assigning real design radius or cant.
steps.observation: 觀察平面方向平順，是否仍有垂向坡度或接續問題。
steps.observationEn: Check whether a smooth plan alignment still leaves vertical-gradient or transition issues.
steps.failure: 只看列車最高速度，就認定所有曲線都能以同速通過。
steps.failureEn: Assuming every curve supports a train’s maximum rated speed.
steps.check: 交付平面及縱向問題各一項，說明缺少的驗證資料。
steps.checkEn: Provide one plan and one vertical-profile question with missing verification data.

knowledge.title: 速度與曲率
knowledge.text: 橫向運動反應取決於速度與曲率的組合，而非車輛標稱速度。
knowledge.textEn: Lateral motion depends on the combination of speed and curvature, not the vehicle’s rated speed alone.

knowledge.title: 平順接續
knowledge.text: 方向或坡度變化需要連續性考量，不能只把直線片段接起來。
knowledge.textEn: Direction and gradient changes require continuity considerations rather than simply joining straight segments.

options: 車輛靜態長度是否自行縮短
橫向動態反應與舒適性如何改變
既有曲線的幾何是否因速度而自動改變
optionsEn: Whether static vehicle length automatically shortens
How lateral response and comfort change
Whether curve geometry automatically changes with speed
quiz.question: 同一曲線提高示意速度時，最合理的研究問題是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: If illustrative speed increases on the same curve, which question is most relevant?
quiz.explanation: 速度變動改變動態需求；不能假定幾何或車輛尺寸會自行補償。
quiz.explanationEn: Changing speed alters dynamic demands; geometry and vehicle dimensions do not automatically compensate.

steps.title: 追蹤地層下陷到軌道
steps.objective: 分辨均勻沉降與差異沉降的介面影響。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish interface effects of uniform and differential settlement.
steps.instruction: 用同一條示意軌道畫均勻下降與局部下降兩種剖面。將地面觀測、橋墩位移與軌道高低資料列成三層，說明不能互相替代的理由。
steps.instructionEn: Draw uniform and localized settlement beneath the same illustrative track. Separate ground observations, pier movement and track levels into three evidence layers and explain their limits.
steps.observation: 比較總沉降相近的兩例，局部坡折是否不同。
steps.observationEn: Compare local gradient changes in examples with similar total settlement.
steps.failure: 以沿線平均沉降值代表所有局部軌道變化。
steps.failureEn: Using average line-wide settlement to represent every local track change.
steps.check: 指出最需補充局部量測的位置，並維持共同高程基準。
steps.checkEn: Identify locations needing local measurements and retain a common elevation datum.

knowledge.title: 差異變形
knowledge.text: 鄰近支承的相對變形會影響幾何連續性，不能只看平均值。
knowledge.textEn: Relative movement of neighboring supports affects geometric continuity and is not captured by an average.

knowledge.title: 跨層證據
knowledge.text: 地盤、土建與軌道的反應需對齊位置和時間才可比較。
knowledge.textEn: Ground, civil and track responses must share location and time references to be compared.

options: 所有支承一起均勻下降的一段必定較差
僅憑總沉降即可判定兩者完全相同
沉降集中在短距離內的一段
optionsEn: The uniformly settling section must be worse
Total settlement alone proves the sections identical
The section where settlement is concentrated over a short distance
quiz.question: 兩段總沉降相同，哪段仍可能有較大的幾何變化？
quiz.questionEn: Two sections have equal total settlement. Which may still have greater geometric change?
quiz.explanation: 沉降的空間分布會改變坡度與曲率，即使總量相同。
quiz.explanationEn: Spatial distribution changes slope and curvature even when total settlement is equal.

steps.title: 檢查橋梁與軌道支承介面
steps.objective: 把預鑄構件交接連到軌道幾何基準。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect precast-member handover to track-geometry references.
steps.instruction: 以自繪高架橋分開橋墩、支承、梁體與軌道層，標出縱向伸縮和量測基準。列出梁體就位後，軌道專業仍需取得的幾何與狀態資料。
steps.instructionEn: Separate piers, bearings, girders and track layers in a viaduct sketch. Mark longitudinal movement and survey references; list geometry and state records needed by the track team after girder placement.
steps.observation: 注意梁體就位合格不等於軌道精度與長期位移已被驗證。
steps.observationEn: Accepted girder placement does not establish track precision or long-term movement behavior.
steps.failure: 將橋梁竣工標高直接當成最終鋼軌標高，忽略中間構造。
steps.failureEn: Treating bridge as-built level as final rail level while omitting intermediate layers.
steps.check: 完成土建到軌道的介面表，至少含基準、可動方向與待補資料。
steps.checkEn: Complete a civil-to-track interface sheet including reference, movement direction and missing records.

knowledge.title: 層間累積
knowledge.text: 各層厚度、調整與變形共同決定鋼軌最終幾何。
knowledge.textEn: Layer thickness, adjustment and deformation together determine final rail geometry.

knowledge.title: 可動支承
knowledge.text: 設計允許的伸縮與需要限制的位移，應在模型中分清。
knowledge.textEn: Intended movement and movement that must be restrained should be distinguished in the model.

options: 中間層與調整量共同決定軌面位置
梁頂標高與軌面必定相同
軌道幾何與土建從不互相影響
optionsEn: Intermediate layers and adjustments determine rail position
Girder-top and rail elevations are necessarily identical
Track geometry and civil works never interact
quiz.question: 梁頂標高正確，為何還需軌道層交接資料？
quiz.questionEn: Why are track-layer records needed even if girder-top elevation is correct?
quiz.explanation: 交接要追蹤完整尺寸鏈，而不是只驗證其中一層。
quiz.explanationEn: Handover must trace the full dimensional chain, not only one layer.

stages.title: 路線與土建介面
stages.description: 將路線幾何、地盤與橋梁條件連到軌道需求。
stages.descriptionEn: Connect alignment, ground and bridge conditions to track requirements.

steps.title: 比較軌道形式及轉換區
steps.titleEn: Compare track forms and transition zones
steps.objective: 理解不同軌道形式回應不同介面要求。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand how track forms respond to different interface needs.
steps.instruction: 依探索館說明，整理版式軌道、道岔附近的配置和低振動軌道三種功能重點。畫兩種剛度不同的軌道相接，列出需量測的幾何與動態反應。
steps.instructionEn: Using the museum overview, compare slab-track, turnout-area and low-vibration functions. Sketch a transition between track forms of different stiffness and identify geometric and dynamic observations.
steps.observation: 觀察靜態軌面平順是否仍可能有支承剛度變化。
steps.observationEn: Recognize that a smooth static rail profile can still cross a stiffness change.
steps.failure: 把全線軌道假定為單一材料與單一剛度。
steps.failureEn: Assuming one material and stiffness for the entire line.
steps.check: 比較表須有功能、支承差異及轉換區待驗證事項。
steps.checkEn: Include purpose, support differences and transition-zone verification needs.

knowledge.title: 功能選型
knowledge.text: 道岔定位、一般正線與振動控制可能需要不同構造組合。
knowledge.textEn: Turnout positioning, ordinary main line and vibration control can require different structural arrangements.

knowledge.title: 過渡反應
knowledge.text: 支承特性突變可影響輪軌互動，需與幾何一起檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Abrupt support-property changes can affect wheel–rail interaction and should be examined with geometry.

options: 有，軌頂相同即代表剛度相同
沒有，支承特性與動態反應仍需證據
只要列車靜止不晃就已足夠
optionsEn: Yes; equal rail elevation means equal stiffness
No; support properties and dynamic response still need evidence
A stationary train not rocking is sufficient
quiz.question: 兩段軌頂高程相同，是否已證明轉換區動態相容？
quiz.questionEn: Two sections have equal rail elevation. Does that prove dynamic compatibility at the transition?
quiz.explanation: 高程只描述幾何的一部分，無法取代動態介面檢核。
quiz.explanationEn: Elevation describes only part of geometry and does not replace dynamic interface review.

steps.title: 分開道岔位置與路線確認
steps.titleEn: Separate turnout position from route confirmation
steps.objective: 辨識機械位置、位置證據與通行授權。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish mechanical position, position evidence and movement authority.
steps.instruction: 畫一個簡化分岔軌道，用不同符號表示移動部件、位置回報和控制狀態。寫出「位置未知」的桌上案例，說明為何不能只看遠景照片決定路線。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch a turnout with separate symbols for moving components, position indication and control state. Describe an unknown-position tabletop case and why a distant photograph cannot establish a route.
steps.observation: 觀察部件看似靠妥與完整位置證據是否為不同層次。
steps.observationEn: Distinguish apparent mechanical closure from complete position evidence.
steps.failure: 將目視位置直接等同於系統已確認且允許列車通行。
steps.failureEn: Equating visual position with system confirmation and authority to move.
steps.check: 表格保留機械、檢知、控制三欄，未知狀態不得寫成已驗證。
steps.checkEn: Keep mechanical, detection and control columns separate; do not relabel unknown states as verified.

knowledge.title: 證據鏈
knowledge.text: 幾何位置、檢知資訊和系統授權屬於不同介面。
knowledge.textEn: Physical position, detection information and system authority are different interfaces.

knowledge.title: 未知狀態
knowledge.text: 資料不足不是正常的同義詞，應保留為待查證。
knowledge.textEn: Insufficient information is not equivalent to normal operation and must remain unresolved.

options: 外觀可替代全部系統證據
可直接推論控制授權已成立
機械觀察已記錄，系統位置仍未驗證
optionsEn: Appearance replaces all system evidence
Movement authority can be inferred directly
Mechanical observation recorded; system position unverified
quiz.question: 道岔外觀位置正確但位置回報未確認，最合適的課程記錄是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: A turnout looks aligned but its position indication is unconfirmed. What is the best learning record?
quiz.explanation: 不同證據欄位不能互相冒充，未知應清楚留下。
quiz.explanationEn: Different evidence fields are not interchangeable; unknowns must remain visible.

steps.title: 建立集電與供電介面圖
steps.objective: 分辨供電存在與受電弓接觸品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish supply availability from pantograph contact quality.
steps.instruction: 自繪變電、電車線、受電弓與車輛用電鏈，另加接觸幾何示意。以「有電但接觸不穩」假想例子列出電氣與機械兩類證據，不提供接近帶電設備的作業。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch supply, catenary, pantograph and vehicle demand, adding contact geometry. For an invented energized-but-unstable-contact case, list electrical and mechanical evidence without field work near live equipment.
steps.observation: 比較上游供電量測與車上集電狀態能回答的不同問題。
steps.observationEn: Compare the questions answered by upstream supply readings and onboard collection observations.
steps.failure: 看到上游電壓正常就排除所有集電介面問題。
steps.failureEn: Ruling out every collection-interface problem because upstream voltage is normal.
steps.check: 每一個假說須連到電氣或機械證據，並註明位置與時間。
steps.checkEn: Link each hypothesis to electrical or mechanical evidence with location and time.

knowledge.title: 機電接觸
knowledge.text: 集電同時是電能傳遞與運動接觸問題。
knowledge.textEn: Current collection involves both electrical transfer and moving mechanical contact.

knowledge.title: 觀測位置
knowledge.text: 不同測點位於不同系統邊界，不能隨意互相替代。
knowledge.textEn: Measurements at different system boundaries cannot be substituted indiscriminately.

options: 該測點電壓在觀察期間穩定
受電弓全程接觸品質必定良好
所有車上負載均無異常
optionsEn: Voltage at that location was stable during observation
Pantograph contact was necessarily good throughout
Every onboard load was fault-free
quiz.question: 上游電壓穩定能直接證明哪項？
quiz.questionEn: What does stable upstream voltage directly establish?
quiz.explanation: 測量只能先支持其所在邊界與時間範圍內的結論。
quiz.explanationEn: A measurement initially supports conclusions within its own location and time boundary.

steps.title: 理解ATC速度防護證據
steps.objective: 區分行車計畫、允許速度與實際速度。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish timetable intent, permitted speed and actual speed.
steps.instruction: 自繪三條明確標成假想的曲線：計畫速度、允許速度、實際速度。找出實際速度接近或超出允許範圍的區域，說明需要防護而非只調整時刻表。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch explicitly fictional planned, permitted and actual speed curves. Identify where actual speed approaches or exceeds permission and explain the need for protection rather than merely changing the timetable.
steps.observation: 觀察晚點與違反速度限制是不同問題。
steps.observationEn: Distinguish lateness from violation of a speed limit.
steps.failure: 因列車晚點就把時刻表目標速度當成可突破的安全限制。
steps.failureEn: Treating a timetable target as permission to exceed a safety limit because the train is late.
steps.check: 標示三種曲線的來源角色與一個資料不足的區段。
steps.checkEn: Identify the role behind each curve and one section with insufficient information.

knowledge.title: 控制約束
knowledge.text: 允許速度受前方路線與行車條件影響，不只取決於車輛能力。
knowledge.textEn: Permitted speed depends on route and traffic conditions, not only vehicle capability.

knowledge.title: 安全與服務
knowledge.text: 準點目標與防護約束不是同一層級的判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Punctuality objectives and protection constraints are different decision layers.

options: 計畫速度自動覆蓋允許速度
計畫需受當時允許範圍約束
只要實際速度低於車輛最高速度即可
optionsEn: Planned speed automatically overrides permission
The plan remains constrained by current permission
Actual speed need only remain below vehicle maximum
quiz.question: 計畫速度高於當時允許速度，應如何解讀課程圖？
quiz.questionEn: Planned speed exceeds current permitted speed. How should the diagram be interpreted?
quiz.explanation: 車輛能力與時刻表不能取代路線與行車防護條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Vehicle capability and timetable goals do not replace route and traffic protection conditions.

stages.title: 軌道與機電整合
stages.description: 辨識軌道形式、道岔、集電與控制的不同證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Identify distinct evidence for track forms, turnouts, current collection and control.

steps.title: 配對災害與偵測位置
steps.objective: 說明不同災害需要不同觀察量與布設邏輯。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain why hazards require different observables and siting logic.
steps.instruction: 自繪隧道口、跨河橋、邊坡及一般路段，將落石、水位、地滑、風與地震觀察配到合理區域。為每一配對補一句不能保證偵測所有事件的理由。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch a portal, river bridge, slope and ordinary section. Assign rockfall, water level, slope movement, wind and earthquake observations, noting one limitation for each.
steps.observation: 觀察單一感測器位置能代表的空間範圍是否有限。
steps.observationEn: Consider the spatial limits of any one detector location.
